baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins تُحِبُّونَ (ح ب ب) directly to ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ (ع ج ل).
baseline_models.mechanism: Clinging preference assigns extra value to whatever haste brings forward, so temporal nearness becomes an affectively weighted criterion rather than a neutral fact.

activation_trace.role: Love as clinging attachment supplies the persistent preference that weights one temporal horizon over another.
Hastening and bringing forward supplies the preferred object's defining temporal position.

changed_reading.before: You like what is available now.
changed_reading.after: You cling to what can be brought forward, allowing affection itself to bias temporal judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The seed image within ح ب ب and premature bearing within ع ج ل remain attached to تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A carried kernel is valued as though it should already be fruit: love of the immediate becomes demand for a yield before its process has reached full term.

activation_trace.role: The seed-grain supplies latent growth and a result still carried in kernel form.
Premature bearing supplies the image of a viable outcome forced before full term.

changed_reading.before: You prefer outcomes that arrive soon.
changed_reading.after: You love to treat an early stage as completed yield, pulling fruit from a process before its term.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The immobility branch of ح ب ب and shortcut-travel branch of ع ج ل form a paradox inside the two focus roots.
baseline_models.mechanism: The attempt to shorten the route fixes the traveler at the nearest station; attachment to speed becomes inability to depart the immediate horizon.

activation_trace.role: The exhausted animal fixed in place supplies attachment as arrested movement.
Quick travel and the nearer shortcut supply the attempted acceleration that paradoxically ends in stasis.

changed_reading.before: Preference for the immediate makes movement toward satisfaction faster.
changed_reading.after: Preference for the shortcut can immobilize the chooser at the nearest horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier desire aims to rupture restraint in the space ahead; the focus diagnosis then makes love of the brought-forward horizon the affective engine that wants an unobstructed future for transgression.

activation_trace.role: Will and desire supply the deliberate appetite that drives the earlier clause.
Deviation from truth and tearing a cover supply the boundary-breaking action desired.
What lies in front and near supplies the forward field in which restraint is to be ruptured.
Clinging preference makes the later focus clause a diagnosis of the earlier will.
Bringing forward turns the space ahead into a horizon demanded on the chooser's terms.

structural_cues: 75:5 combines desire, transgressive rupture, and أَمَامَهُ in one clause before the affective diagnosis at 75:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a desired rupture 'ahead' and later love of what is brought forward; I infer that the latter names the motive of the former. A live alternative is that أَمَامَهُ marks continued conduct rather than a deliberately cleared future horizon.

changed_reading.before: Loving the immediate is passive attraction to present pleasure.
changed_reading.after: Loving the immediate actively seeks a forward field in which accountability will not interrupt desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier ledger of what a person advances and delays converts immediacy from an object category into a policy of temporal allocation whose choices remain reportable.

activation_trace.role: Advancing and precedence supply the positive side of a recorded temporal ordering.
Deferral to a later time supplies the complementary side of that ordering.
Clinging preference supplies the bias by which items are advanced or delayed.
Bringing forward links the focus object to the earlier advance-delay pair.

structural_cues: 75:13 pairs قَدَّمَ and أَخَّرَ under a future disclosure, while 75:20 turns the same temporal asymmetry into an object of love.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reportable advance-delay pair and the focus supplies affective preference for what is advanced; I infer a scheduling mechanism in which love governs priority. Alternatively, 75:13 may classify deeds only by when they occurred, without implying deliberate prioritization.

changed_reading.before: The immediate is a fixed realm that people happen to prefer.
changed_reading.after: The immediate is continually produced by what affection promotes now and postpones, with that temporal allocation entering the ledger.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prohibition on hasty tongue movement is followed by an ordered reception process: gathering and recitation, then following, then explanation. The focus diagnosis therefore reaches epistemic method: love of immediacy tries to possess or voice a whole before reception has completed its sequence.

activation_trace.role: Hastening and bringing forward repeats the focus root in an explicit prohibition on premature reception.
Gathering dispersed parts into a whole supplies the first stage that haste must not preempt.
Recitation and reading supply the delivered form that precedes the receiver's response.
Following trace after trace supplies disciplined reception after recitation rather than ahead of it.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies the later explanatory completion.
Clinging preference turns a momentary rush into a recurring disposition toward premature possession.
The brought-forward immediate generalizes the nearby prohibited haste into the focus diagnosis.

structural_cues: 75:16-19 forms a prohibition followed by a staged sequence: gathering/recitation, following, and only then explanation.
The ع ج ل root occurs both in 75:16 and in the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact root recurrence and the ordered reception sequence; I infer that this local haste exemplifies the broader affective diagnosis in 75:20. A live alternative is that 75:16 addresses a narrowly prophetic act and 75:20 begins a separate general indictment.

changed_reading.before: You prefer present goods over future goods.
changed_reading.after: You also prefer premature cognitive possession: speaking, grasping, or closing meaning before gathering, following, and explanation have run their course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The balanced next clause exposes preference as displacement: attachment to the brought-forward object consumes attention by leaving the later one unattended.

activation_trace.role: Leaving a thing supplies the enacted cost of the focus preference.
What comes after the first supplies the neglected temporal counterpart to the immediate.
Clinging preference supplies the positive attachment whose negative face is abandonment.
The brought-forward object supplies one pole of the temporal tradeoff.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 balances second-person plural verbs تُحِبُّونَ and تَذَرُونَ with the paired objects ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ and ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a syntactically paired love/leave contrast; I infer an attention-allocation arrow in which attachment to one horizon produces neglect of the other. Coexistence is logically possible, but the paired wording portrays displacement rather than simple comparison.

changed_reading.before: Love of the immediate is merely stronger liking for one of two goods.
changed_reading.after: Love of the immediate is an allocating act whose observable form is abandonment of the later horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shortcut fantasy is reversed by the death sequence: separation becomes certain, limb is wound around limb, and self-directed travel becomes passive conveyance toward a destination.

activation_trace.role: Separation and distinguishing between two things supply the irreversible break that ends ordinary route choice.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies bodily constriction rather than free forward motion.
Driving and urging supply movement imposed on the traveler toward the stated destination.
The animal fixed in place supplies the focus-side loss of mobility.
Quick travel and the nearer shortcut supply the agency claim that the death sequence reverses.

structural_cues: 75:28-30 moves in sequence from recognized separation, through entwined legs, to ٱلْمَسَاقُ toward the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, bodily wrapping, and driving; I infer an agency reversal from choosing the quick route to being conveyed on a route one does not choose. Alternatively, the death sequence may negate worldly control generally without specifically answering the shortcut branch.

changed_reading.before: The immediate is a quicker route selected by an autonomous traveler.
changed_reading.after: The preferred shortcut masks a terminal reversal in which the chooser loses both mobility and control of the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing origin sequence moves from seminal fluid through implanted attachment to creation and completed proportion. It gives the premature-yield baseline a concrete maturation process: an early stage is real, but it is not yet the whole for which it is being prepared.

activation_trace.role: Fluid ranging from a drop and including semen supplies the small material beginning of a longer process.
Semen from which formation is determined supplies latent form rather than finished form.
A pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies the attached intermediate stage.
Completed formation and balanced shape supply maturation beyond mere implantation.
Integrity and completion in the thing itself supply the process's formed endpoint.
The carried kernel supplies a focus-side beginning whose value lies partly in unrealized growth.
Premature bearing supplies the focus-side error of demanding the endpoint before full term.

structural_cues: 75:37-38 progresses from نُطْفَةً to عَلَقَةً and then, with sequential particles, to creation and proportioning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged formation sequence and the focus branches supply seed and premature bearing; I infer an analogy between created maturation and ethical temporal judgment. A live alternative is that 75:37-38 argues only for creative power and does not comment on the affect in 75:20.

changed_reading.before: The immediate is simply the first item available in time.
changed_reading.after: The immediate is a genuine but unfinished stage falsely loved as if it were the completed form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The vessel-and-provision mechanism is surprising because both images are materially distant from the ordinary verbal sense of love. It remains anchored in exact focus-root branches and coherently models near-term satiety; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not substitute 'ration' for ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُحِبُّونَ and ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ activate filling within ح ب ب and hurried provision within ع ج ل.

activation_trace.role: Filling with water supplies a finite near-term capacity that can be saturated.
Hurried traveler provision supplies the quickly consumed content that fills that capacity.

changed_reading.before: The immediate is liked because it is temporally close.
changed_reading.after: The immediate functions like a hurried ration: it fills present capacity so completely that deferred nourishment is no longer sought.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The spark reading is surprising because it uses a remote nominal branch of ح ب ب, not the ordinary sense of تُحِبُّونَ. The exact focus branch and the earlier flash branch keep the visual mechanism anchored; downstream prose should present it only as a fleeting-value analogy, not as lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The weak-spark branch of focus-root ح ب ب refracts the love of ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ through the earlier flash at 75:7.

activation_trace.role: Lightning and sudden gleam supply the visible intensity of a momentary flash.
Weak useless sparks supply brilliance without durable benefit as the focus-side value image.
The quickly brought-forward horizon supplies the short duration in which the flash attracts.

changed_reading.before: The immediate attracts by offering a stable present benefit.
changed_reading.after: The immediate may attract as a bright but useless flash whose intensity is mistaken for duration or benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from affective attachment to embryonic attachment and risks turning a sequence into psychology. It remains valid as an echo between the focus love branch and an exact context branch that names passion clinging to the heart; downstream prose should label the developmental recursion as exploratory rather than causal exegesis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُحِبُّونَ anchors affective clinging, while the later عَلَقَةً cue supplies an attachment image that can reflect back on that love.

activation_trace.role: Love as clinging attachment supplies the focus affect that can become arrested.
Passion attaching to the heart supplies an explicit cross-domain echo of affective clinging.
Premature bearing supplies the arrest of development at an attachment-stage logic.

changed_reading.before: Love of the immediate is an adult preference among temporal goods.
changed_reading.after: Love of the immediate can be pictured as attachment arrested at an origin-stage, refusing the maturation that attachment was meant to serve.

strongest_changes: The exact ع ج ل recurrence in 75:16 and the ordered 75:17-19 sequence changed a generic present-bias reading into premature cognitive possession.
The paired love/leave syntax of 75:20-21 exposed attachment as an allocation that abandons the deferred horizon.
The formation sequence in 75:37-38 gave the focus branches a maturation model in which the immediate is real but incomplete.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the focus clause function simultaneously as affective diagnosis, reception discipline, route-and-agency reversal, and maturation failure without requiring those mechanisms to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 75:16-19 is meant to exemplify the general diagnosis in 75:20 or merely precedes it as a distinct address.
Whether the advance-delay pair in 75:13 encodes deliberate priority or only reports temporal order.
How much interpretive weight the material seed, shortcut, ration, and spark branches can bear beyond contained analogy.
